description: For equivalence relations \(R\) on \(A\) and \(S\) on \(B\), a map \(h:A\to B\) preserving equivalence induces \(A/R\to B/S\), sending \([a]\) to \([h(a)]\).
signature:
Quotient.map.{u_1, u_2} {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} {sa : Setoid α} {sb : Setoid β} (f : α → β)
  (h : ∀ ⦃a b : α⦄, a ≈ b → f a ≈ f b) : Quotient sa → Quotient sb
